{{Top|leg}} {{Youmay|the [[Jedi Enclaves|Jedi enclave]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]|the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on Tython}} {{Structure |image=[[File:Master_Retreat.png]] |name=Masters' Retreat |constructed= |destroyed= |type=Retreat{{TORcite|type=location|Masters' Retreat|Tython}} |location=[[Tython/Legends|Tython]] |interest= |rebuilt= |builder= |height= |width= |affiliation=*[[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] *[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] }} {{Quote|Ah, Padawan. I heard your shuttle arriving. I'm Master Syo Bakarn, of the Jedi Council. Welcome to Tython. This is the ancestral home of our order, where the Jedi first came to be. And where our most promising Padawans complete their training.|Syo Bakarn welcomes the future Barsen'thor to Tython at the Masters' Retreat|audio=Bakarn-Welcome-SWTOR.flac|{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|The Path of a Jedi|Tython}}}} The '''Masters' Retreat''' was structure on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] used by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Built on a rocky outcrop and surrounded by a [[Masters' Retreat lake|lake]], it consisted of a large cupola-topped disc with a pillared balcony beneath it and a pair of landing pads extending over the [[Water/Legends|water]]. Many [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] visited the retreat for peace and tranquility and around [[3643 BBY]], two Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] separately arrived at the retreat by [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] to start their [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Jedi Trials]]. The [[The Barsen'thor|new Padawan]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yuon Par]] was greeted by [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] member [[Syo Bakarn]] at the retreat but was soon dispatched to the [[Tythonian Gnarls]] region by Par to recover a set of teaching [[Hologram/Legends|holograms]] being [[Flesh Raider uprising|attacked]] by [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Flesh Raider]]s. The Padawan who would one [[Standard day/Legends|day]] be known as the [[Hero of Tython]] was greeted by [[Derrin Weller]], watchman of the training grounds in the Gnarls. After Weller received a distress call from the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] Padawan [[Unaw Aharo]] about Flesh Raiders [[Attack on the Gnarls Outpost|attacking]], he dispatched the Padawan to go and help defeat the raiders. ==Description== ===Lakeside retreat=== [[File:MastersRetreatStatue-SWTOR.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=A group of human Jedi gather around the base of a silver and gold humanoid statue on the balcony of the Masters' Retreat.|Humanoid statues decorated the balcony of the Masters' Retreat.]] The Masters' Retreat was a multi-story structure located on the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Built on a rocky outcrop, it overhung above a walled-in [[Masters' Retreat lake|lake]] and had its back against a [[Stone/Legends|stone]] rise. The top of the building was disc shaped with a shallow cupola roof and ring of [[Viewport|windows]] circling it. Beneath the disc was a railed balcony overlooking the [[Water/Legends|water]], lit by a ring of lights on the disc's underside. The balcony included an alcove back toward the rock wall with various piping on its walls and a gold and silver statue of a [[Clothing/Legends|robed]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] standing at its rear. A matching statue stood out on the balcony facing the first, with a red and gray bench placed on either side of it. ===Jedi rooms=== A smaller version of the statues stood against buttresses to each side of the alcove's entrance and faced one of the two central pillars holding up the disc, with four additional pillars at the structure's edge. On each side of the balcony there were doorways into small meeting rooms, one inside each buttress and one on each side with its back to the rock wall. [[File:MastersRetreatOffice-SWTOR.png|thumb|left|300px|alt=Two Jedi stand behind a table speaking with a supply officer in one of the circular rooms of the Masters' Retreat. The central space is empty while crates and cupboards line the curved walls.|A room at the Masters' Retreat]] The circular rooms all contained a single table and chairs and various consoles. From in front of the doorways, a ramp curved down to a circular landing pad on each side of the Masters' Retreat. An [[Antenna/Legends|antenna]] protruded below each landing pad toward the water below, with an additional antenna below the balcony's center and another at the apex of the roof. The [[Color/Legends|white]] and blue flags of the Jedi Order hung across the balcony-level walls of the Masters' Retreat, which were primarily gray with red detailing. ==History== ===Away from conflict=== {{Quote|There's a speeder here that'll take you to—hang on. Getting an emergency signal.|Derrin Weller mentions the air taxis at the Masters' Retreat|audio=Weller-Speeder-SWTOR.flac|{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Attack of the Flesh Raiders|Tython}}}} Following the [[Sacking of Coruscant|destruction]] of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and the relocation of the Jedi Order to Tython, members of the order made use of the Masters' Retreat during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Many Jedi returned to the Masters' Retreat to seek peace and tranquility, away from the [[Flesh Raider uprising|conflicts]] around Tython's [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]] to the south.''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'' [[File:MastersRetreatLandingPad-SWTOR.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=A gray protocol droid stands between two bright yellow air taxis on a landing pad above the lake surrounding the Masters' Retreat.|Air taxis used on of the landing pads at the Masters' Retreat during the Cold War.]] In [[3643 BBY]],{{TOR_dates|1}} one of retreat's two landing pads was used by [[air taxi]]s, with a [[protocol droid]] overseeing them. A [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] was also stationed at the retreat, and various [[Quartermaster/Legends|supply officers]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], including [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|initiates]] and [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|guardians]], spent [[Time/Legends|time]] on the balcony. This included [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Benn]] and the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] Jedi [[Matare (Zabrak)|Matare]], who discussed how dangerous the nearby [[Tythonian Gnarls]] area had become and whether it was a good idea to send Padawans there. Various crates and pallets were spread across the balcony and landing pads. ===A powerful new arrival=== {{Quote|Yuon. I was beginning to worry.''"
"''So you've arrived safely, my Padawan. I'm sorry I can't greet you properly, but we already have a crisis on our hands.|Syo Bakarn and Yuon Par|audio=Bakarn-Par-Greeting-SWTOR.flac|}} [[File:ConsularArrives-SWTOR.png|thumb|left|300px|alt=A ''Rendaran''-class assault shuttle perches on a landing pad at the Masters' Retreat with a lake visible behind it and the head of a humanoid statue visible in the foreground.|Yuon Par's new Padawan arrived at the Masters' Retreat in a shuttle.]] That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], a [[The Barsen'thor|Jedi Padawan]] who was notably strong in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]—and would one day claim the title of [[Barsen'thor]]{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Vivicar Awaits|Vivicar's ship}}—arrived at the Masters' Retreat to begin his[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]] [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Jedi Trials]]. Having traveled in a [[Rendaran-class assault shuttle|''Rendaran''-class assault shuttle]] from [[Tython system/Legends|orbit]], he disembarked on one of the landing pads and made his way up to the balcony, catching the attention of Benn briefly. The [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] was then greeted by [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] member [[Syo Bakarn]], who wished to see the Padawan who had caused such a stir with his abilities. Bakarn led the Padawan into one of the small meeting rooms, where the new arrival's master, [[Yuon Par]], arrived late, wasting no time with introductions and explaining that there was a crisis at hand: members of the native [[Flesh Raider]] [[Species/Legends|species]] were attacking [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojectors]] in the Gnarls that displayed teaching [[Hologram/Legends|holograms]] of the earliest Jedi. Par tasked her new Padawan with rescuing the recordings and so he left the retreat in a waiting air taxi, heading to the Gnarls. ===A hero's first steps=== {{Quote|Welcome to Tython, Padawan. Everyone at the temple is looking forward to meeting you.|Derrin Weller greets the future Hero of Tython at the Masters' Retreat|audio=Weller-Welcome-SWTOR.flac|}} [[File:Weller-Initiates-SWTOR.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=The light-skinned human Jedi Derrin Weller stands with a pair of Jedi in Padawan's robes on the balcony at the Masters' Retreat.|Derrin Weller greeted the future Hero of Tython at the Masters' Retreat and soon dispatched them to fight Flesh Raiders.]] Around the same time as Par's Padawan, another Jedi Padawan with notable dueling skills who would become known as the [[Hero of Tython]]{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Fate of the Jedi|the ''Opressor''}} arrived at the Masters Retreat in a shuttle to begin their own Jedi Trials. As they disembarked on the landing pad, the Jedi [[Derrin Weller]]—watchman of the Jedi training grounds in the Gnarls and greeter of new arrivals—dismissed a trio of Jedi Initiates on the balcony and approached the new arrival to greet them. Leading the Padawan past Benn and Matare to one of the retreat's rooms, he explained that they would be assigned a new master for the Trials and that one of the air taxis would take them to their next destination. However, before he could finish, Weller was interrupted by an emergency signal from the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] Jedi [[Unaw Aharo]], who reported via hologram that Flesh Raiders were attacking the Padawan training grounds in the Gnarls with [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]. Weller dispatched the Padawan to help fend off the natives, getting to work at a console to send a warning to others about the attack including the Jedi Council. The Padawan took an air taxi to the Gnarls and Weller soon followed. ==Behind the scenes== The Masters' Retreat first appeared in [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of the Masters' Retreat}} *''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}} ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Rückzugsort der Meister |es=Retiro de Maestros |fr=Maison des maîtres |it=Rifugio dei Maestri |pl=Enklawa Jedi na Tythonie |deGA=1 }} [[Category:Locations of the Jedi Order]] [[Category:Tython locations]]
